title: The Bellows Ghost
text: In a ruined forge the bellows still pump on their own, wheezing, and the coals glow for no one. An anvil holds a blade half made, still cherry red. The hammer beside it is warm, as if the smith has only stepped out and will be back any moment.

options.label: The strongest takes up the warm hammer, to finish what the smith began.

outcomes.text: The bellows breathe in time with the hammer, as if someone guides it. The blade comes out fine; somewhere, the smith is pleased.
The coals flare white at the first stroke, angry that a stranger dared touch the smith's work.

options.label: Take the iron and the tools. The smith will not be coming back.

outcomes.text: The iron is good and the old tools still sharp. The bellows wheeze faster as you carry them out.

options.label: Bank the fire, as a smith would at the end of a long day.

outcomes.text: The bellows sigh to a stop, as if someone could rest at last. As the coals fade, the forge becomes only a forge.
